name: Shopify Change Intelligence
description: Ask any public Shopify store a question. Free live snapshot; paid change intelligence (new/removed products, price moves, stock) and competitor reports. AI agents pay in USDC on Base via x402.

localizations.name: Shopify 店铺变化情报
localizations.description: 向任何公开 Shopify 店铺提问。免费实时快照；付费获取变化情报（新品/下架、价格涨跌、库存）与竞品报告。AI Agent 通过 x402 用 Base 网络 USDC 自动付费。

tools.name: shopify_snapshot
tools.description: FREE. Live snapshot of a public Shopify store: product count, price range, availability and a sample of products. Reads the public /products.json feed.

tools.name: shopify_changes
tools.description: PAID ($0.05 USDC on Base via x402). Change intelligence vs the last snapshot: new/removed products, price increases/decreases, restock/out-of-stock.

tools.name: shopify_intel_report
tools.description: PAID ($0.50 USDC on Base via x402). Full-catalog competitor intelligence report: price bands, median/range, top discounts and hikes, stock signals, executive takeaways.

tools.name: shopify_batch_watch
tools.description: PAID ($0.03 USDC per store on Base via x402, max 50). Watches a whole set of competitor Shopify stores in one call; returns per-store change counts.

tools.name: shopify_landscape
tools.description: PAID ($5 USDC on Base via x402, up to 10 stores). Strategic competitive landscape: positions an anchor store against competitors by median price, flags premium/value players, price-war and stock signals.

anchor.description: Your store domain to position against peers
